note: CodeMirror Editor integrates the CodeMirror library into Drupal. Global config object codemirror_editor.settings has cdn (bool, default true), minified (bool, default true), theme (string, default 'default') and language_modes (sequence of mode plugin ids, default [xml]); settings form at /admin/config/content/codemirror behind the 'administer codemirror editor' permission. It provides plugins all id 'codemirror_editor' (an @Editor for text formats, a #[Filter] TYPE_TRANSFORM_IRREVERSIBLE, and a @FieldWidget + @FieldFormatter for string_long/text_long), a #type=>'codemirror' render element, and a codemirror_mode YAML plugin type (plugin.manager.codemirror_mode, MODULE.codemirror_modes.yml; 12 modes ship). Drush command codemirror:download self-hosts the library when cdn is off. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real codemirror_editor.settings config: introspection reads back the configured theme/modes and the cdn flag; execution changes the preloaded language_modes and switches to a self-hosted un-minified build, verified by pure config reads. Shipped defaults are restored explicitly on cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: I want syntax-highlighted code editing in Drupal using the CodeMirror Editor module. What are the main ways it lets me use CodeMirror (on a text format, on a field, in content, in a custom form)?
evals.expected_output: It provides plugins all with id codemirror_editor: an Editor plugin for a text format's editor, a Filter plugin to render code in content, and a field widget + field formatter for string_long/text_long fields; plus a #type => 'codemirror' render element for custom forms and a codemirror_mode plugin type for language modes.

evals.prompt: Where are the global settings for the Drupal CodeMirror Editor module, and which keys control loading the library from a CDN, the editor theme, and which language modes are preloaded?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/config/content/codemirror (permission 'administer codemirror editor') and edits the codemirror_editor.settings config object: cdn (load from CDN, default true), minified (default true), theme (default 'default'), and language_modes (sequence of mode ids, default [xml]).

evals.prompt: If I turn off the CDN option in the CodeMirror Editor module and want to self-host the CodeMirror library, is there a Drush command to fetch it? What is it?
evals.expected_output: Yes: run `drush codemirror:download` (alias codemirror-download). It downloads the CodeMirror JS/CSS into libraries/codemirror so the module can self-host it when codemirror_editor.settings cdn is false.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the CodeMirror Editor module has a non-default editor theme configured. Inspect the live configuration and state which CodeMirror theme is set.
evals.expected_output: The theme is 'material': codemirror_editor.settings has theme set to material (and language_modes [css, javascript, twig]).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the CodeMirror library being loaded from a CDN or self-hosted? Inspect the CodeMirror Editor configuration and say which, and how you can tell.
evals.expected_output: It is self-hosted, not from a CDN: codemirror_editor.settings has cdn set to false, which means the library must be served locally from libraries/codemirror.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the CodeMirror Editor module so that the CSS and Twig language modes are preloaded globally (in addition to whatever is already there). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: codemirror_editor.settings language_modes includes both 'css' and 'twig' (e.g. add them on the settings form at /admin/config/content/codemirror, or set the language_modes sequence in config and save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the CodeMirror Editor module to stop using the CDN and instead serve a self-hosted, non-minified build of the CodeMirror library. Apply the change to the live site (you do not need to actually download the library files).
evals.expected_output: codemirror_editor.settings has cdn set to false AND minified set to false (e.g. untick 'Load the library from CDN' and 'Use minified version' on the settings form, or set both booleans to false in config and save).
